timeline.text_zh: 币安发布第三次恢复更新，称被盗资产中已补充约90%（此前约为80%），资金来自其预留的逾63.4亿美元公司资金，并提供了储备金证明快照。
timeline.text_en: Binance's third recovery update said about 90% of stolen assets have now been replenished, up from roughly 80%, using more than $6.34 billion in company funds set aside, and provided a Proof of Reserves snapshot.

timeline.text_zh: 币安遭遇创纪录的63亿美元黑客攻击，表示将自行承担损失而非转嫁给用户，并称约30亿美元被盗资金已被冻结，在11月3日美国大选前引发政治人物评论。
timeline.text_en: Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion hack, said it would absorb the losses rather than pass them to users and reported roughly $3 billion of the stolen funds already frozen, drawing commentary from political figures ahead of the Nov. 3 US election.

timeline.text_zh: 币安表示已覆盖约80%的黑客损失，并称未来几天将重点恢复提现、通过储备金证明加强透明度、追回被冻结资金并发布事件分析报告；初步调查仍未发现钱包私钥泄露证据。
timeline.text_en: Binance said it has covered about 80% of the hack losses and that in the coming days it will focus on restoring withdrawals, strengthening transparency via proof of reserves, recovering frozen funds, and publishing an incident analysis; the preliminary investigation has still found no evidence of wallet private-key leakage.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 公开以币安约64亿美元黑客事件为由，推动对离岸加密交易所实施美国联邦监管；同时币安表示调查发现“更多入侵点”，CEO Richard Teng 称攻击过程更复杂，并非仅利用一名工程师的权限。
timeline.text_en: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig publicly cited Binance's ~$6.4 billion hack to argue for U.S. federal oversight of offshore crypto exchanges; separately, Binance said its investigation uncovered “additional points of breach,” with CEO Richard Teng calling it a more complex attack process that did not simply use one engineer's permissions.

timeline.text_zh: 币安发布第二份安全事件更新，通报调查、基础设施加固以及防范和追回资金损失方面的 24 小时进展，并将此事列为最高优先级。
timeline.text_en: Binance issued a second security incident update, reporting 24-hour progress on investigation, infrastructure hardening, and efforts to prevent and recover fund losses while treating the matter as its top priority.

timeline.text_zh: Decrypt 报道补充了市场影响与资金追回细节：比特币较美联储决议后水平仅下跌约4%–6%，约13亿美元杠杆头寸被清算；攻击者仍持有约42万ETH和18,270 BTC（约24亿美元，无法被稳定币发行方冻结）；币安称约30亿美元已冻结，并正通过公开市场和场外交易买入缺失代币，提现预计约45小时内恢复。
timeline.text_en: Decrypt added market-impact and recovery details: Bitcoin fell only about 4%–6% from its post-Fed level, roughly $1.3 billion in leveraged bets were liquidated; the attacker still holds about 420,000 ETH and 18,270 BTC (~$2.4 billion that stablecoin issuers cannot freeze); Binance says about $3 billion is frozen and it is buying missing tokens on the open market and over the counter, with withdrawals expected to resume in about 45 hours.

timeline.text_zh: 美国特勤局加入币安黑客案调查；Circle 冻结了约8.23亿美元与攻击相关的 USDC，Tether 冻结了约9.751亿美元 USDT，两家稳定币发行方均表示配合执法。
timeline.text_en: The U.S. Secret Service joined the Binance hack investigation; Circle froze approximately $823 million in USDC and Tether froze approximately $975.1 million in USDT connected to the attack, with both stablecoin issuers coordinating with law enforcement.

timeline.text_zh: 加密货币相关股票在币安63亿美元黑客事件后大幅下跌，Coinbase跌超13%，Circle、Strategy、IREN、Figure跌8-10%。
timeline.text_en: Crypto-linked stocks sold off sharply following the $6.3B Binance hack, with Coinbase falling over 13% and Circle, Strategy, IREN, and Figure dropping 8-10%.

timeline.text_zh: 币安 CEO 邓伟政表示，交易所将动用超过 63.4 亿美元的公司储备——其中包括受影响代币中的 50 亿美元——来弥补本周黑客攻击造成的全部损失；此前攻击者利用自毁机制和 EIP-7702 委托绕过了正常的审批控制，提现目标于周日恢复，完整的储备证明于周一公布。
timeline.text_en: Binance CEO Richard Teng said the exchange will cover all losses from this week's hack using more than $6.34 billion of company reserves — including $5 billion in the affected tokens — after an attacker used a self-destruct mechanism and an EIP-7702 delegation to bypass normal approval controls, with withdrawals targeted for restoration by Sunday and a full proof of reserves by Monday.

timeline.text_zh: TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将币安约64亿美元黑客攻击归因于朝鲜关联黑客组织 TraderTraitor；同时 CZ 公开回应马斯克对币安事件的嘲讽，币安联席 CEO Yi He 表示公司年收入足以覆盖损失、无需出售 SpaceX 持股。
timeline.text_en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the ~$6.4B Binance hack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor; separately, CZ publicly rebuked Elon Musk over his mockery of Binance, and co-CEO Yi He said annual revenue is sufficient to cover losses without selling SpaceX shares.

focus.title_zh: ICE与Trade.xyz合作推出美国监管的永续期货交易场所
focus.title_en: ICE partners with Trade.xyz to launch US-regulated perpetual futures venue
focus.summary_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 重新发布经修改的合作公告，重申计划推出基于 Hyperliquid 的美国受监管永续期货市场，但强调该计划及杠杆交易均尚待监管批准，尚无获批或上线。
focus.summary_en: ICE and Trade[XYZ] have reposted an amended partnership announcement reiterating plans for a US-regulated perpetual futures venue built on Hyperliquid, while stressing that the plan and leveraged trading remain subject to regulatory approvals; no approval or launch has occurred.
focus.latest_update_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
focus.latest_update_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
focus.background_zh: HIP-3（即“构建者部署永续合约”）是 Hyperliquid 的一项升级，于 2025 年 10 月 13 日在主网上线，允许独立运营者在 Hyperliquid 基础设施上无需许可地创建自己的永续合约市场。永续合约是没有到期日、跟踪标的资产价格的衍生品合约，据 DefiLlama 数据，Hyperliquid 是此类合约全球最大的去中心化交易所。据报道，美国总统特朗普曾在 8 月 19 日表示，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 正在推动以“完全合规且合法的方式”将 Hyperliquid 引入美国。被列为 trade[XYZ] 投资人的亿万富翁投资者 Stanley Druckenmiller 表示“很高兴成为 trade(xyz) 的投资者”，ICE 也进行了战略投资。
focus.background_en: HIP-3, or "Builder-Deployed Perpetuals", is a Hyperliquid upgrade that went live on mainnet on October 13, 2025, allowing independent operators to permissionlessly launch their own perpetual futures markets on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that track an asset's price without an expiration date, and Hyperliquid is the largest decentralized exchange for such instruments by DefiLlama data. According to the reporting, President Donald Trump said on Aug. 19 that CFTC Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in a "fully compliant and legal fashion." Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller, listed as a trade[XYZ] investor, said he was "excited to be an investor in trade(xyz)", and ICE has made a strategic investment.
focus.latest_summary_zh: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
focus.latest_summary_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
focus.market_impact_zh: 该消息直接影响了 Hyperliquid 原生代币 HYPE，其 24 小时内上涨约 20%，价格突破 96 美元，逼近 9 月创下的 97.96 美元历史高点，显示 HYPE 代币与 Hyperliquid 链上永续合约场所是市场对该消息最直接的敞口。由于该计划仍需监管批准且尚未上线，任何向美国受监管场所的推进都将通过监管与清算渠道传导，而非立竿见影的流动性变化。
focus.market_impact_en: The announcement moved Hyperliquid's native token HYPE, which rose about 20% over 24 hours to trade above $96, approaching September's all-time high of $97.96, reflecting how the HYPE token and Hyperliquid's onchain perps venue are the most direct market exposure to the news. Any shift toward a regulated US venue would transmit through the regulatory and clearing channel rather than through immediate liquidity changes, since the plan remains subject to approvals and no market is live.

timeline.text_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
timeline.text_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.

timeline.text_zh: 纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与 Trade[XYZ] 宣布计划寻求监管批准，推出覆盖加密资产与传统资产的美国永续期货市场，消息推动 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 上涨约 20%，逼近其 9 月创下的约 98 美元历史高点。
timeline.text_en: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the NYSE, and Trade[XYZ] announced plans to seek regulatory approval for US perpetual futures markets covering crypto and traditional assets, sending Hyperliquid's HYPE up roughly 20% toward its September all-time high near $98.

timeline.text_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 签署最终协议，成为 Trade[XYZ] 受监管市场的独家运营方并进行战略投资；产品仍需监管批准且尚无上线日期。消息推动 HYPE 上涨约 13% 至约 91 美元。
timeline.text_en: ICE signed a definitive agreement to become the exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets and make a strategic investment; the product still needs regulatory approvals and has no launch date. The news pushed HYPE up about 13% to roughly $91.

timeline.text_zh: OKX CEO Star 表示，OKX 将协助把永续合约引入美国受监管市场，其结构为：ICE 运营一个新的美国交易与清算场所，提供覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品、外汇和加密货币的 24/7 永续合约；Trade.xyz 作为 ICE 的独家合作伙伴；由 ICE 与 OKX 的合资企业负责零售分销。
timeline.text_en: OKX CEO Star said OKX will help bring perpetual futures to the US regulated market through a structure in which ICE operates a new US trading and clearing venue for 24/7 perps across equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto, Trade.xyz serves as ICE's exclusive partner, and an ICE-OKX joint venture handles retail distribution.

timeline.text_zh: Trade.xyz 创始人公开确认获得 ICE 战略投资，并确认双方计划在获得 CFTC 批准后推出面向美国市场的 Hyperliquid 永续合约平台，覆盖加密资产并支持全天候交易。
timeline.text_en: Trade.xyz's founder publicly confirmed the strategic investment from ICE and confirmed the joint plan to launch a CFTC-approved US-facing perpetual futures platform on Hyperliquid, covering crypto assets with 24/7 trading.

timeline.text_zh: 洲际交易所计划与 Trade xyz 合作并入股，推出一个受美国监管的永续期货交易场所，运行于 Hyperliquid 基础设施之上，配备专门的清算和 KYC/AML 合规，覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品和外汇，尚待监管批准。
timeline.text_en: Intercontinental Exchange plans to partner with Trade xyz, taking an equity stake, to launch a US-regulated perpetual futures venue running on Hyperliquid infrastructure with dedicated clearing and KYC/AML compliance, covering equities, indexes, commodities, and FX pending regulatory approval.

focus.title_zh: OpenAI 洽谈最高 300 亿美元融资，估值约 1.25 万亿美元
focus.title_en: OpenAI in talks to raise up to $30B at roughly $1.25T valuation
focus.summary_zh: OpenAI 目前寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值融资约 200 亿美元，较此前 300 亿美元目标下调；首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，背景是 AI 概念股抛售及 Anthropic 即将 IPO。
focus.summary_en: OpenAI now seeks about $20B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, down from the prior $30B target; the first close is expected below $20B amid an AI stock selloff and Anthropic's upcoming IPO.
focus.latest_update_zh: OpenAI 将最新一轮融资目标规模从 300 亿美元下调 100 亿美元至约 200 亿美元，并将估值预期从 1.4 万亿美元下调至 1.25 万亿美元；知情人士称首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，因部分投资者下调认购额度。
focus.latest_update_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B from $30B to about $20B and its valuation expectation from $1.4T to $1.25T; sources said the first close is expected below $20B as some investors reduced commitments.
focus.background_zh: Coatue 是一家总部位于纽约、聚焦科技领域的投资管理公司，成立于 1999 年，由 Philippe Laffont 领导，同时投资公开市场与私募市场。过桥融资是一种过渡性资金，用于帮助公司在两次重大融资或关键节点之间衔接。
focus.background_en: Coatue is a New York-based, technology-focused investment management firm founded in 1999 and led by Philippe Laffont, investing across both public and private markets. A bridge round is interim financing meant to carry a company from one major financing or milestone to the next.
focus.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B to about $20B and its valuation from $1.4T to $1.25T, with the first close expected to fall short as investors trim commitments amid a broad AI stock selloff.
focus.latest_summary_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B to about $20B and its valuation from $1.4T to $1.25T, with the first close expected to fall short as investors trim commitments amid a broad AI stock selloff.
focus.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 本身没有直接的加密资产敞口，因此传导主要经由情绪层面：AI 与算力主题的加密代币交易者会把这类大规模 AI 融资和海湾主权资本的动向视为叙事热度的参考，而非直接驱动因素。
focus.market_impact_en: OpenAI has no direct crypto exposure, so any transmission runs through sentiment: large AI capital-formation and Gulf sovereign capital flows are watched by traders in AI- and compute-themed crypto tokens as a gauge of narrative momentum rather than as a direct driver.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI 将最新一轮融资目标规模从 300 亿美元下调 100 亿美元至约 200 亿美元，并将估值预期从 1.4 万亿美元下调至 1.25 万亿美元；知情人士称首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，因部分投资者下调认购额度。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B from $30B to about $20B and its valuation expectation from $1.4T to $1.25T; sources said the first close is expected below $20B as some investors reduced commitments.

timeline.text_zh: 美国盘前综述要点包括：特斯拉与 SpaceX 可能面临反垄断审查、OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值接近完成最高 300 亿美元融资、Calpers 减持“七巨头”敞口、SK 海力士取消 Solidigm 的 IPO 计划，以及美国现货比特币和以太坊 ETF 分别流出 6.35 亿美元和 1.1 亿美元。
timeline.text_en: US premarket roundup highlights a possible Tesla-SpaceX antitrust review, OpenAI's near-completed up-to-$30B raise at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, Calpers trimming Magnificent Seven exposure, SK Hynix canceling Solidigm's IPO plans, and $635M/$110M outflows from US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs.

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，OpenAI正寻求以1.25万亿美元投前估值融资至多300亿美元，阿联酋投资者与Coatue共同领投，另有一项关于阿联酋额外算力的商业协议正在谈判中，目标是在一周内签署协议。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly seeking to raise up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with UAE investors co-leading alongside Coatue and a separate commercial agreement for additional UAE-based compute under negotiation, targeting signed agreements within the week.

timeline.text_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 正接近完成同一轮融资，寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值筹集最多 300 亿美元，阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 共同领投，并计划在下周结束前签署协议；最终融资规模仍未确定，公司将其定位为潜在 IPO 前的“机会型过桥融资”。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly nearing the close of the same funding round, seeking up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with UAE investors and Coatue co-leading and agreements targeted by the end of next week; the final size is still being determined, and the raise is positioned as opportunistic bridge financing ahead of a possible IPO.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI正推动在Anthropic预计于11月中旬IPO之前完成约300亿美元融资，估值可能超过1.4万亿美元，软银、MGX及现有投资方正在洽谈，并援引GPT-6 Astra之后500亿美元的年化收入以及年底700亿美元的目标。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is pushing to close a roughly $30 billion funding round at a valuation potentially exceeding $1.4 trillion before Anthropic's expected mid-November IPO, with SoftBank, MGX and existing backers in talks, citing annualized revenue of $50 billion after GPT-6 Astra and a year-end target of $70 billion.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI 正与总部位于阿布扎比的 MGX 及其他阿联酋投资基金洽谈，由后者领投至少 300 亿美元的融资轮，贝莱德正讨论参与，投前估值固定约为 1.4 万亿美元，同时该公司推迟了 IPO。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI在将IPO推迟至2026年之后，正以约1.4万亿美元估值寻求至少300亿美元新融资，其年化收入已超过400亿美元；而Anthropic预计将于11月IPO，潜在估值超过2万亿美元。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is seeking at least $30 billion in new funding at roughly a $1.4 trillion valuation after postponing its IPO beyond 2026, with annualized revenue surpassing $40 billion, while Anthropic is expected to IPO in November at a potential valuation above $2 trillion.

timeline.text_zh:
据 BlockBeats 援引彭博社 9 月 30 日的报道，OpenAI 计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元。该报道描述的是一项融资计划，并未表明交易已经完成。

若按此规模完成，这将是史上规模最大的私募融资之一，所募资金将直接投入 OpenAI 的算力建设，并影响其与其他前沿 AI 实验室的竞争格局。

该数字来源于彭博社，时间标注为 9 月 30 日；报道所描述的核心要素是融资金额、估值，以及该融资目前仍属计划、而非已完成交易这一事实。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly planning to raise $30 billion in funding at a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.

focus.title_zh: 多家企业反对OKX与ICE未经同意代币化其股票，反对企业数量上升
focus.title_en: Crypto fundraising limits added to CLARITY Act as vote looms
focus.summary_zh: 截至 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，已有 38 家原定上市企业反对其股票在 OKXICE TSV 被代币化交易，占 62 家中的 61% 以上；自行托管钱包中代币化股票的 SIPC 保护不确定性仍未解决。
focus.summary_en: As of the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers object to their shares being tokenized and traded on OKXICE TSV, more than 61%; uncertainty remains over whether tokenized shares in self-custodied wallets would receive SIPC protection.
focus.latest_update_zh: 沃尔玛、礼来、嘉年华邮轮、Arcos Dorados 和信诺加入反对 OKX 与 ICE 代币化股票计划的行列；据 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，原定上市的 62 家企业中已有 38 家提出异议，占比超过 61%。
focus.latest_update_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados and Cigna joined the opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan; according to the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers have objected, exceeding 61%.
focus.background_zh: OKXICE TSV是纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与OKX美国控股公司按50比50组建的合资企业，计划通过OKX的XLayer区块链上经许可的Uniswap v4资金池，实现美国股票代币化的7×24小时交易，并以USDC等稳定币作为交易对。其10月4日的初始公告提出上线来自62家公司的63只代币化股票，而包括富国银行和Arm在内的部分后来的反对者并不在最初名单中。SEC于2026年9月17日发布创新豁免，要求交易场所在上线第三方代币化股票版本前至少30天通知相关公司，若公司在期限内书面反对，则该股票不得上线。已获得SEC代币化证券试点批准的纳斯达克表示，将把自家股票排除在该豁免之外。
focus.background_en: OKXICE TSV is a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's U.S. holding company, planning 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's XLayer blockchain paired with stablecoins such as USDC. Its original Oct. 4 notice proposed 63 tokenized stocks from 62 companies, and several later objectors, including Wells Fargo and Arm, were not on that initial roster. The SEC issued the innovation exemption on Sept. 17, 2026, requiring a venue to notify a company at least 30 days before offering a third-party tokenized version of its shares, with a written objection within that window barring the listing. Nasdaq, which won SEC approval for its own tokenized securities pilot, has said it will opt its shares out of the exemption.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados, and Cigna joined opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan, bringing objecting issuers to 38 of 62, or more than 61%.
focus.latest_summary_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados, and Cigna joined opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan, bringing objecting issuers to 38 of 62, or more than 61%.
focus.market_impact_zh: 这些反对压缩了OKXICE TSV实际可上线的股票供给，在尚未启动前就为这一规模最大的代币化股票场所之一设下可见上限，也检验了在发行人选择退出时SEC豁免能否规模化。该信号还波及更广泛的代币化股票与RWA（现实世界资产）板块——决定哪些股票能够上链交易的约束正在从场所技术转向发行人同意。
focus.market_impact_en: The objections shrink the supply of equities that OKXICE TSV can actually list, putting a visible ceiling on one of the largest tokenized-equity venues before launch and testing whether the SEC exemption can scale when issuers opt out. The signal extends to the broader tokenized-equity and RWA segment, where issuer consent — rather than venue technology — is emerging as the binding constraint on which stocks can trade onchain.

timeline.text_zh: 沃尔玛、礼来、嘉年华邮轮、Arcos Dorados 和信诺加入反对 OKX 与 ICE 代币化股票计划的行列；据 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，原定上市的 62 家企业中已有 38 家提出异议，占比超过 61%。
timeline.text_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados and Cigna joined the opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan; according to the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers have objected, exceeding 61%.

timeline.text_zh: 据加密记者 Eleanor Terrett 10 月 28 日报道，摩根大通、AMD、应用材料、可口可乐、Adobe、戴尔及 Sandisk 反对 OKXICE 代币化其股份，披露的反对公司总数从 26 家升至 33 家。
timeline.text_en: Crypto reporter Eleanor Terrett reported on Oct. 28 that JPMorgan, AMD, Applied Materials, Coca-Cola, Adobe, Dell and Sandisk objected to OKXICE tokenizing their shares, raising the disclosed number of opposing companies from 26 to 33.

timeline.text_zh: Intel、Oracle、IBM 和 IonQ 加入反对其股票在 OKXICE TSV 被代币化交易的发行方名单，使披露的反对总数从 22 家增至 26 家；10 月 26 日公告还指出，自行托管的代币化股票能否获得 SIPC 保护存在不确定性。
timeline.text_en: Intel, Oracle, IBM and IonQ joined the list of issuers objecting to their shares being tokenized and traded on OKXICE TSV, raising the disclosed total from 22 to 26; the Oct. 26 notice also flagged uncertainty over whether self-custodied tokenized shares would receive SIPC protection.

timeline.text_zh: IBM、Oracle、Intel 和 IonQ 反对 OKX 与 ICE 在未经同意的情况下依据 SEC 创新豁免将其股票代币化，使反对企业总数达到 26 家。
timeline.text_en: IBM, Oracle, Intel and IonQ objected to OKX and ICE tokenizing their stocks without consent under the SEC innovation exemption, bringing the total number of opposing companies to 26.

timeline.text_zh: 参议员 Cynthia Lummis 表示，对加密融资的新限制——将 Reg Crypto 年度豁免上限从 7500 万美元降至 5000 万美元，并增加 2 亿美元终身限额——已被纳入 CLARITY Act，而民主党人最终对这些规则投了反对票。
timeline.text_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said new restrictions on crypto fundraising—lowering the annual Reg Crypto exemption cap from $75M to $50M and adding a $200M lifetime limit—have been incorporated into the CLARITY Act, with Democrats ultimately voting against the rules.

timeline.text_zh: 据路透社看到的一份监管文件，包括富国银行、Arm Holdings和Intuit在内的另外六家公司反对其股票在OKXICE平台被代币化，使已披露的反对发行方总数从16家增至22家；文件未说明这些公司反对的具体原因。
timeline.text_en: A regulatory filing seen by Reuters showed six more companies — including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit — will not allow their shares to be tokenized on the OKXICE platform, raising the total disclosed objecting issuers from 16 to 22; the filing did not state their specific reasons.

timeline.text_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
timeline.text_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.

timeline.text_zh: OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo公开回应发行方反对，称16家企业反对其股票被代币化交易是“正常反应”且符合预期，并重申该模式允许企业自主选择加入或退出。
timeline.text_en: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo publicly responded to issuer opposition, calling the objections from 16 companies to their shares being tokenized a “normal reaction” and expected, while reiterating that the model lets issuers opt in or out.

timeline.text_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛及其他四家公司加入反对其股票在计划中的OKX-洲际交易所代币化股票平台交易的发行人名单，使总数增至16家，而该平台表示也可能上架由发行人自行代币化的股票。
timeline.text_en: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and four other companies joined the list of issuers objecting to their shares being traded on the planned OKX-Intercontinental Exchange tokenized stock venue, raising the total to 16, while the venue said it may also list stocks tokenized by issuers themselves.

timeline.text_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛、高通、卡特彼勒、麦当劳和西部数据这7家企业新提出反对，使已披露的反对发行方总数从9家增至16家（其中15家属于原62家公司名单，Cerebras不在最初名单内），OKXICE于10月19日更新了公开声明。
timeline.text_en: Seven more issuers — Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's and Western Digital — have objected, raising total disclosed objecting issuers from nine to 16 (15 of them on the original 62-company roster, with Cerebras outside that list), per the joint venture's 19 October updated public statement.

focus.title_zh: 英伟达同意以130亿美元收购Hugging Face，美国司法部展开审查
focus.title_en: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B; US DOJ reviews the deal
focus.summary_zh: 英伟达收购Hugging Face的交易面临美国司法部问询，仍待监管批准，预计2027年上半年完成。
focus.summary_en: Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face is under US Department of Justice inquiry, still pending regulatory approval, with closing expected in H1 2027.
focus.latest_update_zh: 美国司法部对英伟达收购Hugging Face展开问询，关注其控制AI模型分发渠道可能偏向自家GPU、排挤竞争对手；交易仍需监管批准，预计2027年上半年完成。
focus.latest_update_en: The US Department of Justice has opened an inquiry into Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face, examining whether control of the main AI model distribution channel could steer developers to Nvidia GPUs and disadvantage rivals; the deal still requires regulatory approval and is expected to close in H1 2027.
focus.latest_summary_zh: The US Department of Justice has opened an inquiry into Nvidia's roughly $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, probing whether control of the main AI model distribution channel could let Nvidia steer developers toward its own GPUs and disadvantage rivals, with the deal still requiring regulatory approval and expected to close in the first half of 2027.
focus.latest_summary_en: The US Department of Justice has opened an inquiry into Nvidia's roughly $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, probing whether control of the main AI model distribution channel could let Nvidia steer developers toward its own GPUs and disadvantage rivals, with the deal still requiring regulatory approval and expected to close in the first half of 2027.

timeline.text_zh: 美国司法部对英伟达收购Hugging Face展开问询，关注其控制AI模型分发渠道可能偏向自家GPU、排挤竞争对手；交易仍需监管批准，预计2027年上半年完成。
timeline.text_en: The US Department of Justice has opened an inquiry into Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face, examining whether control of the main AI model distribution channel could steer developers to Nvidia GPUs and disadvantage rivals; the deal still requires regulatory approval and is expected to close in H1 2027.

timeline.text_zh: 两位知情人士表示，美国司法部正在审查英伟达对AI平台Hugging Face的收购。
timeline.text_en: Two people familiar with the matter said the US Department of Justice is reviewing Nvidia's acquisition of AI platform Hugging Face.

focus.title_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包供应链植入窃密组件事件
focus.title_en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident
focus.summary_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入窃密组件事件仍在发展中：Ledger已披露犯罪团伙通过东南亚分销渠道转售被植入设备的做法并收紧销售和交付规则；新加坡警方最新披露当地零售商售出的部分设备含恶意植入，自9月10日以来至少两起案件造成约350万新加坡元损失，Ledger正复核案件，警方调查持续，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911追踪资金。
focus.summary_en: The Ledger hardware wallet supply-chain implant incident remains developing: Ledger has disclosed that a criminal group redistributed tampered devices through Southeast Asian distribution channels and tightened sales and delivery rules; Singapore police have now disclosed that some devices sold by local retailers contained malicious implants, with at least two cases since September 10 causing about S$3.5 million in losses, while Ledger reviews the cases, police investigations continue, and authorities and SEAL 911 trace funds.
focus.latest_update_zh: 新加坡警方10月28日披露，当地零售商售出的部分Ledger硬件钱包被植入可窃取助记词或私钥的恶意硬件；自9月10日以来至少报告两起案件，损失约350万新加坡元（约270万美元），Ledger正复核相关案件，警方调查仍在进行。
focus.latest_update_en: Singapore police disclosed on October 28 that some Ledger hardware wallets sold by local retailers contained malicious hardware implants capable of stealing recovery phrases or private keys; at least two cases have been reported since September 10, causing about S$3.5 million (~$2.7 million) in losses, with Ledger reviewing the cases and police investigations ongoing.
focus.background_zh: Ledger 是一家法国硬件钱包厂商，2014 年成立于巴黎，其设备将私钥离线保存。恢复短语（又称助记词）是可在另一台设备上恢复非托管钱包及其全部私钥的备份，因此一旦被窃取，硬件钱包的防护意义即被抵消。供应链攻击针对的往往是产品周边的薄弱环节——例如分销与零售渠道，而非厂商自身的系统。
focus.background_en: Ledger is a French hardware wallet maker founded in Paris in 2014; its devices store private keys offline. A recovery phrase, also called a seed phrase, is the backup that can restore a non-custodial wallet and all its keys on another device, which is why capturing it defeats the purpose of a hardware wallet. Supply-chain attacks target the less-secure links around a product — such as distribution and retail — rather than the manufacturer's own systems.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Singapore police disclosed that Ledger hardware wallets bought from local retailers contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal recovery phrases or private keys, with at least two cases since September 10 causing roughly S$3.5 million ($2.7 million) in losses while Ledger reviews the incidents and investigations continue.
focus.latest_summary_en: Singapore police disclosed that Ledger hardware wallets bought from local retailers contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal recovery phrases or private keys, with at least two cases since September 10 causing roughly S$3.5 million ($2.7 million) in losses while Ledger reviews the incidents and investigations continue.
focus.market_impact_zh: 该事件影响的是自托管领域的硬件钱包板块：暴露的是零售分销渠道风险，而非设备固件本身的缺陷，这可能使用户更加关注签名设备的购买来源与渠道。更广泛的市场影响主要经由围绕自托管工具的情绪传导，而非直接作用于资产价格。
focus.market_impact_en: The incident bears on the hardware-wallet segment of self-custody: it exposes a retail-distribution channel risk rather than a flaw in the devices' firmware, which could shift user scrutiny toward where and how signing devices are sourced. Any broader market effect would run through sentiment around self-custody tooling rather than through asset prices directly.

timeline.text_zh: 新加坡警方10月28日披露，当地零售商售出的部分Ledger硬件钱包被植入可窃取助记词或私钥的恶意硬件；自9月10日以来至少报告两起案件，损失约350万新加坡元（约270万美元），Ledger正复核相关案件，警方调查仍在进行。
timeline.text_en: Singapore police disclosed on October 28 that some Ledger hardware wallets sold by local retailers contained malicious hardware implants capable of stealing recovery phrases or private keys; at least two cases have been reported since September 10, causing about S$3.5 million (~$2.7 million) in losses, with Ledger reviewing the cases and police investigations ongoing.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger披露，一个高度组织化的犯罪团伙花费数百万美元购买正版Ledger设备，植入隐藏组件以在初始化过程中窃取助记词，并通过东南亚分销商转售，促使Ledger暂停销售并更改东南亚和香港授权经销商的交付规则，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911合作追踪资金。
timeline.text_en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group spent millions of dollars buying genuine Ledger devices, implanting hidden components to steal seed phrases during initialization and reselling them via Southeast Asian distributors, prompting Ledger to suspend sales and change delivery rules at authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong while it works with law enforcement and SEAL 911 to trace the funds.

timeline.text_zh: Chainalysis 报告称，一名任务诈骗者因购买三台被篡改的 Ledger 设备而损失 60 BTC（约 480 万美元）；同一供应链攻击的链上被盗资金总额增至逾 1.034 亿美元，涉及 530 个地址。
timeline.text_en: Chainalysis reported a task-scammer lost 60 BTC (~$4.8M) after buying three tampered Ledger devices; the same supply-chain attack's onchain theft total rose to over $103.4M across 530 addresses.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger披露，一个有组织团伙花费数月时间将恶意硬件植入正版Ledger设备，并通过东南亚转售渠道重新分销，以拦截助记词并盗取用户资产；同时确认其安全芯片、BOLOS操作系统和服务器基础设施未遭入侵。
timeline.text_en: Ledger disclosed that an organized syndicate spent months implanting malicious hardware into genuine Ledger devices and redistributing them through Southeast Asian resale channels to intercept seed phrases and drain user assets, while confirming its secure element chips, BOLOS OS, and server infrastructure were not compromised.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger首次将事件正式定性为设备离开公司控制后的局部分销渠道攻击，而非系统性供应链攻击，并称芯片、操作系统及服务器未被攻破；同时收紧渠道规则：退货设备即便看似全新、未开封也不得再次出售，产品不得置于货架或展示区，须在后场存放并在购买时交付，渠道须及时上报异常产品；Ledger还表示已赴德国等地门店购买并拆检设备、检查仓库及自有库存样本，均未发现篡改，并正与执法机构追踪资金。
timeline.text_en: Ledger formally characterized the incident as a localized distribution-channel attack after devices left its control, rather than a systemic supply-chain compromise, saying its chips, OS, and servers were not breached; it also tightened channel rules — returned devices cannot be resold even if seemingly new or unopened, products must not be displayed on shelves and must be stored in backrooms and delivered at purchase, and channels must promptly report anomalous products; Ledger added it bought and inspected devices at stores in Germany and elsewhere and checked warehouses and its own inventory samples without finding tampering, while working with law enforcement to trace funds.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
timeline.text_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.

timeline.text_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。
timeline.text_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道称，Mark Karpelès 已在菲律宾官方经销商 LazMall 销售的 Ledger 钱包中也发现间谍软件，使受影响经销商范围进一步扩大；Ledger 最新声明称尚未核实来自其他渠道购买签名器的资金流出，并正在审查其他签名器和地点的植入物报告，同时 CryptoBilis 在调查期间继续停售。
timeline.text_en: The new report says Mark Karpelès has also found spyware in Ledger wallets sold by official Philippine reseller LazMall, further widening the affected-reseller scope; Ledger’s latest statement says it has not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere and is reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations, while CryptoBilis remains not selling wallets during the investigation.

timeline.text_zh: 新增：Ledger官方确认已与MediaMarkt Saturn协调暂停德国线上及线下门店销售，以配合一名德国用户疑似植入物报告的调查；Ledger表示该报告相关事件暂无资金损失，且无迹象表明其基础设施、系统或服务遭到入侵，客服正在审查报告，Donjon将检查设备。
timeline.text_en: New: Ledger officially confirmed it coordinated with MediaMarkt Saturn to suspend online and in-store sales in Germany pending investigation into a German user's suspected implant report; Ledger said there were no reported fund losses tied to that report and no signs of compromise to its infrastructure, systems, or services, with customer support reviewing the report and Donjon set to inspect devices.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认，东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的钱包中存在未经授权的硬件植入物，该植入物会在设置过程中从设备屏幕读取24词恢复短语，并通过预置eSIM经LTE传输，所有已确认的损失均与通过该经销商购买的设备有关，疑似被盗资金达8600万美元。
timeline.text_en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.

ranking.title_zh: 币安遭大规模黑客攻击，公司承担损失并冻结部分被盗资金
ranking.title_en: Binance hit by large-scale hack, losses covered by company reserves
ranking.summary_zh: 币安仍在处理这起创纪录的约63亿美元黑客事件；其第三次恢复更新称已用逾63.4亿美元公司资金补充约90%的被盗资产，并提供了储备金证明快照。
ranking.summary_en: Binance is still handling the record ~$6.3 billion hack; its third recovery update says about 90% of stolen assets have been replenished from more than $6.34 billion in company funds, with a Proof of Reserves snapshot provided.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 币安发布第三次恢复更新，称被盗资产中已补充约90%（此前约为80%），资金来自其预留的逾63.4亿美元公司资金，并提供了储备金证明快照。
ranking.latest_update_en: Binance's third recovery update said about 90% of stolen assets have now been replenished, up from roughly 80%, using more than $6.34 billion in company funds set aside, and provided a Proof of Reserves snapshot.
ranking.background_zh: CFTC于2026年10月5日发布《预先规则制定通知》，就针对加密资产零售商品交易的定制化监管框架公开征求意见，截止日期为2026年10月20日。在《清晰法案》在参议院停滞之后，该机构加快推进自身规则制定，并另行澄清了美国用户接入离岸加密交易所的相关规则。
ranking.background_en: The CFTC published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking on Oct. 5, 2026, seeking public comment on a fit-for-purpose framework for crypto-asset retail commodity transactions, with comments due Oct. 20, 2026. The agency has pressed ahead with its own rulemaking after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate, and has separately moved to clarify rules on U.S. access to offshore crypto exchanges.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Binance's third recovery update reports that 90% of the stolen assets from its security incident have now been replenished from over $6.34B in company funds set aside to cover hacked losses, alongside a Proof of Reserves snapshot.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Binance's third recovery update reports that 90% of the stolen assets from its security incident have now been replenished from over $6.34B in company funds set aside to cover hacked losses, alongside a Proof of Reserves snapshot.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于市场准入与托管标准：若离岸交易所可通过"联邦选项"在CFTC注册，美国用户获取离岸流动性的条件，以及这些平台面临的网络安全与签名基础设施要求，都将发生变化。该方案目前仍属提案，因此对交易所准入资格或流动性的实际影响，取决于尚未最终敲定的规则制定进程。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through market access and custody standards: if offshore venues can register with the CFTC under a federal option, the terms on which U.S. users reach offshore liquidity, and the cybersecurity and signing-infrastructure requirements those venues face, would both change. The proposal remains a proposal, so any effect on venue eligibility or liquidity is contingent on rulemaking that has not been finalized.

timeline.text_zh: 币安发布第三次恢复更新，称被盗资产中已补充约90%（此前约为80%），资金来自其预留的逾63.4亿美元公司资金，并提供了储备金证明快照。
timeline.text_en: Binance's third recovery update said about 90% of stolen assets have now been replenished, up from roughly 80%, using more than $6.34 billion in company funds set aside, and provided a Proof of Reserves snapshot.

timeline.text_zh: 币安遭遇创纪录的63亿美元黑客攻击，表示将自行承担损失而非转嫁给用户，并称约30亿美元被盗资金已被冻结，在11月3日美国大选前引发政治人物评论。
timeline.text_en: Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion hack, said it would absorb the losses rather than pass them to users and reported roughly $3 billion of the stolen funds already frozen, drawing commentary from political figures ahead of the Nov. 3 US election.

timeline.text_zh: 币安表示已覆盖约80%的黑客损失，并称未来几天将重点恢复提现、通过储备金证明加强透明度、追回被冻结资金并发布事件分析报告；初步调查仍未发现钱包私钥泄露证据。
timeline.text_en: Binance said it has covered about 80% of the hack losses and that in the coming days it will focus on restoring withdrawals, strengthening transparency via proof of reserves, recovering frozen funds, and publishing an incident analysis; the preliminary investigation has still found no evidence of wallet private-key leakage.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 公开以币安约64亿美元黑客事件为由，推动对离岸加密交易所实施美国联邦监管；同时币安表示调查发现“更多入侵点”，CEO Richard Teng 称攻击过程更复杂，并非仅利用一名工程师的权限。
timeline.text_en: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig publicly cited Binance's ~$6.4 billion hack to argue for U.S. federal oversight of offshore crypto exchanges; separately, Binance said its investigation uncovered “additional points of breach,” with CEO Richard Teng calling it a more complex attack process that did not simply use one engineer's permissions.

timeline.text_zh: 币安发布第二份安全事件更新，通报调查、基础设施加固以及防范和追回资金损失方面的 24 小时进展，并将此事列为最高优先级。
timeline.text_en: Binance issued a second security incident update, reporting 24-hour progress on investigation, infrastructure hardening, and efforts to prevent and recover fund losses while treating the matter as its top priority.

timeline.text_zh: Decrypt 报道补充了市场影响与资金追回细节：比特币较美联储决议后水平仅下跌约4%–6%，约13亿美元杠杆头寸被清算；攻击者仍持有约42万ETH和18,270 BTC（约24亿美元，无法被稳定币发行方冻结）；币安称约30亿美元已冻结，并正通过公开市场和场外交易买入缺失代币，提现预计约45小时内恢复。
timeline.text_en: Decrypt added market-impact and recovery details: Bitcoin fell only about 4%–6% from its post-Fed level, roughly $1.3 billion in leveraged bets were liquidated; the attacker still holds about 420,000 ETH and 18,270 BTC (~$2.4 billion that stablecoin issuers cannot freeze); Binance says about $3 billion is frozen and it is buying missing tokens on the open market and over the counter, with withdrawals expected to resume in about 45 hours.

timeline.text_zh: 美国特勤局加入币安黑客案调查；Circle 冻结了约8.23亿美元与攻击相关的 USDC，Tether 冻结了约9.751亿美元 USDT，两家稳定币发行方均表示配合执法。
timeline.text_en: The U.S. Secret Service joined the Binance hack investigation; Circle froze approximately $823 million in USDC and Tether froze approximately $975.1 million in USDT connected to the attack, with both stablecoin issuers coordinating with law enforcement.

timeline.text_zh: 加密货币相关股票在币安63亿美元黑客事件后大幅下跌，Coinbase跌超13%，Circle、Strategy、IREN、Figure跌8-10%。
timeline.text_en: Crypto-linked stocks sold off sharply following the $6.3B Binance hack, with Coinbase falling over 13% and Circle, Strategy, IREN, and Figure dropping 8-10%.

timeline.text_zh: 币安 CEO 邓伟政表示，交易所将动用超过 63.4 亿美元的公司储备——其中包括受影响代币中的 50 亿美元——来弥补本周黑客攻击造成的全部损失；此前攻击者利用自毁机制和 EIP-7702 委托绕过了正常的审批控制，提现目标于周日恢复，完整的储备证明于周一公布。
timeline.text_en: Binance CEO Richard Teng said the exchange will cover all losses from this week's hack using more than $6.34 billion of company reserves — including $5 billion in the affected tokens — after an attacker used a self-destruct mechanism and an EIP-7702 delegation to bypass normal approval controls, with withdrawals targeted for restoration by Sunday and a full proof of reserves by Monday.

timeline.text_zh: TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将币安约64亿美元黑客攻击归因于朝鲜关联黑客组织 TraderTraitor；同时 CZ 公开回应马斯克对币安事件的嘲讽，币安联席 CEO Yi He 表示公司年收入足以覆盖损失、无需出售 SpaceX 持股。
timeline.text_en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the ~$6.4B Binance hack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor; separately, CZ publicly rebuked Elon Musk over his mockery of Binance, and co-CEO Yi He said annual revenue is sufficient to cover losses without selling SpaceX shares.

ranking.title_zh: ICE与Trade.xyz合作推出美国监管的永续期货交易场所
ranking.title_en: ICE partners with Trade.xyz to launch US-regulated perpetual futures venue
ranking.summary_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 重新发布经修改的合作公告，重申计划推出基于 Hyperliquid 的美国受监管永续期货市场，但强调该计划及杠杆交易均尚待监管批准，尚无获批或上线。
ranking.summary_en: ICE and Trade[XYZ] have reposted an amended partnership announcement reiterating plans for a US-regulated perpetual futures venue built on Hyperliquid, while stressing that the plan and leveraged trading remain subject to regulatory approvals; no approval or launch has occurred.
ranking.latest_update_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
ranking.latest_update_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
ranking.background_zh: HIP-3（即“构建者部署永续合约”）是 Hyperliquid 的一项升级，于 2025 年 10 月 13 日在主网上线，允许独立运营者在 Hyperliquid 基础设施上无需许可地创建自己的永续合约市场。永续合约是没有到期日、跟踪标的资产价格的衍生品合约，据 DefiLlama 数据，Hyperliquid 是此类合约全球最大的去中心化交易所。据报道，美国总统特朗普曾在 8 月 19 日表示，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 正在推动以“完全合规且合法的方式”将 Hyperliquid 引入美国。被列为 trade[XYZ] 投资人的亿万富翁投资者 Stanley Druckenmiller 表示“很高兴成为 trade(xyz) 的投资者”，ICE 也进行了战略投资。
ranking.background_en: HIP-3, or "Builder-Deployed Perpetuals", is a Hyperliquid upgrade that went live on mainnet on October 13, 2025, allowing independent operators to permissionlessly launch their own perpetual futures markets on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that track an asset's price without an expiration date, and Hyperliquid is the largest decentralized exchange for such instruments by DefiLlama data. According to the reporting, President Donald Trump said on Aug. 19 that CFTC Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in a "fully compliant and legal fashion." Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller, listed as a trade[XYZ] investor, said he was "excited to be an investor in trade(xyz)", and ICE has made a strategic investment.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
ranking.latest_summary_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 该消息直接影响了 Hyperliquid 原生代币 HYPE，其 24 小时内上涨约 20%，价格突破 96 美元，逼近 9 月创下的 97.96 美元历史高点，显示 HYPE 代币与 Hyperliquid 链上永续合约场所是市场对该消息最直接的敞口。由于该计划仍需监管批准且尚未上线，任何向美国受监管场所的推进都将通过监管与清算渠道传导，而非立竿见影的流动性变化。
ranking.market_impact_en: The announcement moved Hyperliquid's native token HYPE, which rose about 20% over 24 hours to trade above $96, approaching September's all-time high of $97.96, reflecting how the HYPE token and Hyperliquid's onchain perps venue are the most direct market exposure to the news. Any shift toward a regulated US venue would transmit through the regulatory and clearing channel rather than through immediate liquidity changes, since the plan remains subject to approvals and no market is live.

timeline.text_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
timeline.text_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.

timeline.text_zh: 纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与 Trade[XYZ] 宣布计划寻求监管批准，推出覆盖加密资产与传统资产的美国永续期货市场，消息推动 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 上涨约 20%，逼近其 9 月创下的约 98 美元历史高点。
timeline.text_en: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the NYSE, and Trade[XYZ] announced plans to seek regulatory approval for US perpetual futures markets covering crypto and traditional assets, sending Hyperliquid's HYPE up roughly 20% toward its September all-time high near $98.

timeline.text_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 签署最终协议，成为 Trade[XYZ] 受监管市场的独家运营方并进行战略投资；产品仍需监管批准且尚无上线日期。消息推动 HYPE 上涨约 13% 至约 91 美元。
timeline.text_en: ICE signed a definitive agreement to become the exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets and make a strategic investment; the product still needs regulatory approvals and has no launch date. The news pushed HYPE up about 13% to roughly $91.

timeline.text_zh: OKX CEO Star 表示，OKX 将协助把永续合约引入美国受监管市场，其结构为：ICE 运营一个新的美国交易与清算场所，提供覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品、外汇和加密货币的 24/7 永续合约；Trade.xyz 作为 ICE 的独家合作伙伴；由 ICE 与 OKX 的合资企业负责零售分销。
timeline.text_en: OKX CEO Star said OKX will help bring perpetual futures to the US regulated market through a structure in which ICE operates a new US trading and clearing venue for 24/7 perps across equities, indices, commodities, FX and crypto, Trade.xyz serves as ICE's exclusive partner, and an ICE-OKX joint venture handles retail distribution.

timeline.text_zh: Trade.xyz 创始人公开确认获得 ICE 战略投资，并确认双方计划在获得 CFTC 批准后推出面向美国市场的 Hyperliquid 永续合约平台，覆盖加密资产并支持全天候交易。
timeline.text_en: Trade.xyz's founder publicly confirmed the strategic investment from ICE and confirmed the joint plan to launch a CFTC-approved US-facing perpetual futures platform on Hyperliquid, covering crypto assets with 24/7 trading.

timeline.text_zh: 洲际交易所计划与 Trade xyz 合作并入股，推出一个受美国监管的永续期货交易场所，运行于 Hyperliquid 基础设施之上，配备专门的清算和 KYC/AML 合规，覆盖股票、指数、大宗商品和外汇，尚待监管批准。
timeline.text_en: Intercontinental Exchange plans to partner with Trade xyz, taking an equity stake, to launch a US-regulated perpetual futures venue running on Hyperliquid infrastructure with dedicated clearing and KYC/AML compliance, covering equities, indexes, commodities, and FX pending regulatory approval.

ranking.title_zh: OpenAI 洽谈最高 300 亿美元融资，估值约 1.25 万亿美元
ranking.title_en: OpenAI in talks to raise up to $30B at roughly $1.25T valuation
ranking.summary_zh: OpenAI 目前寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值融资约 200 亿美元，较此前 300 亿美元目标下调；首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，背景是 AI 概念股抛售及 Anthropic 即将 IPO。
ranking.summary_en: OpenAI now seeks about $20B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, down from the prior $30B target; the first close is expected below $20B amid an AI stock selloff and Anthropic's upcoming IPO.
ranking.latest_update_zh: OpenAI 将最新一轮融资目标规模从 300 亿美元下调 100 亿美元至约 200 亿美元，并将估值预期从 1.4 万亿美元下调至 1.25 万亿美元；知情人士称首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，因部分投资者下调认购额度。
ranking.latest_update_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B from $30B to about $20B and its valuation expectation from $1.4T to $1.25T; sources said the first close is expected below $20B as some investors reduced commitments.
ranking.background_zh: Coatue 是一家总部位于纽约、聚焦科技领域的投资管理公司，成立于 1999 年，由 Philippe Laffont 领导，同时投资公开市场与私募市场。过桥融资是一种过渡性资金，用于帮助公司在两次重大融资或关键节点之间衔接。
ranking.background_en: Coatue is a New York-based, technology-focused investment management firm founded in 1999 and led by Philippe Laffont, investing across both public and private markets. A bridge round is interim financing meant to carry a company from one major financing or milestone to the next.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B to about $20B and its valuation from $1.4T to $1.25T, with the first close expected to fall short as investors trim commitments amid a broad AI stock selloff.
ranking.latest_summary_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B to about $20B and its valuation from $1.4T to $1.25T, with the first close expected to fall short as investors trim commitments amid a broad AI stock selloff.
ranking.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 本身没有直接的加密资产敞口，因此传导主要经由情绪层面：AI 与算力主题的加密代币交易者会把这类大规模 AI 融资和海湾主权资本的动向视为叙事热度的参考，而非直接驱动因素。
ranking.market_impact_en: OpenAI has no direct crypto exposure, so any transmission runs through sentiment: large AI capital-formation and Gulf sovereign capital flows are watched by traders in AI- and compute-themed crypto tokens as a gauge of narrative momentum rather than as a direct driver.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI 将最新一轮融资目标规模从 300 亿美元下调 100 亿美元至约 200 亿美元，并将估值预期从 1.4 万亿美元下调至 1.25 万亿美元；知情人士称首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，因部分投资者下调认购额度。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B from $30B to about $20B and its valuation expectation from $1.4T to $1.25T; sources said the first close is expected below $20B as some investors reduced commitments.

timeline.text_zh: 美国盘前综述要点包括：特斯拉与 SpaceX 可能面临反垄断审查、OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值接近完成最高 300 亿美元融资、Calpers 减持“七巨头”敞口、SK 海力士取消 Solidigm 的 IPO 计划，以及美国现货比特币和以太坊 ETF 分别流出 6.35 亿美元和 1.1 亿美元。
timeline.text_en: US premarket roundup highlights a possible Tesla-SpaceX antitrust review, OpenAI's near-completed up-to-$30B raise at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, Calpers trimming Magnificent Seven exposure, SK Hynix canceling Solidigm's IPO plans, and $635M/$110M outflows from US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs.

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，OpenAI正寻求以1.25万亿美元投前估值融资至多300亿美元，阿联酋投资者与Coatue共同领投，另有一项关于阿联酋额外算力的商业协议正在谈判中，目标是在一周内签署协议。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly seeking to raise up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with UAE investors co-leading alongside Coatue and a separate commercial agreement for additional UAE-based compute under negotiation, targeting signed agreements within the week.

timeline.text_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 正接近完成同一轮融资，寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值筹集最多 300 亿美元，阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 共同领投，并计划在下周结束前签署协议；最终融资规模仍未确定，公司将其定位为潜在 IPO 前的“机会型过桥融资”。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly nearing the close of the same funding round, seeking up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with UAE investors and Coatue co-leading and agreements targeted by the end of next week; the final size is still being determined, and the raise is positioned as opportunistic bridge financing ahead of a possible IPO.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI正推动在Anthropic预计于11月中旬IPO之前完成约300亿美元融资，估值可能超过1.4万亿美元，软银、MGX及现有投资方正在洽谈，并援引GPT-6 Astra之后500亿美元的年化收入以及年底700亿美元的目标。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is pushing to close a roughly $30 billion funding round at a valuation potentially exceeding $1.4 trillion before Anthropic's expected mid-November IPO, with SoftBank, MGX and existing backers in talks, citing annualized revenue of $50 billion after GPT-6 Astra and a year-end target of $70 billion.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI 正与总部位于阿布扎比的 MGX 及其他阿联酋投资基金洽谈，由后者领投至少 300 亿美元的融资轮，贝莱德正讨论参与，投前估值固定约为 1.4 万亿美元，同时该公司推迟了 IPO。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI在将IPO推迟至2026年之后，正以约1.4万亿美元估值寻求至少300亿美元新融资，其年化收入已超过400亿美元；而Anthropic预计将于11月IPO，潜在估值超过2万亿美元。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is seeking at least $30 billion in new funding at roughly a $1.4 trillion valuation after postponing its IPO beyond 2026, with annualized revenue surpassing $40 billion, while Anthropic is expected to IPO in November at a potential valuation above $2 trillion.

timeline.text_zh:
据 BlockBeats 援引彭博社 9 月 30 日的报道，OpenAI 计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元。该报道描述的是一项融资计划，并未表明交易已经完成。

若按此规模完成，这将是史上规模最大的私募融资之一，所募资金将直接投入 OpenAI 的算力建设，并影响其与其他前沿 AI 实验室的竞争格局。

该数字来源于彭博社，时间标注为 9 月 30 日；报道所描述的核心要素是融资金额、估值，以及该融资目前仍属计划、而非已完成交易这一事实。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI is reportedly planning to raise $30 billion in funding at a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.

ranking.title_zh: 多家企业反对OKX与ICE未经同意代币化其股票，反对企业数量上升
ranking.title_en: Crypto fundraising limits added to CLARITY Act as vote looms
ranking.summary_zh: 截至 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，已有 38 家原定上市企业反对其股票在 OKXICE TSV 被代币化交易，占 62 家中的 61% 以上；自行托管钱包中代币化股票的 SIPC 保护不确定性仍未解决。
ranking.summary_en: As of the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers object to their shares being tokenized and traded on OKXICE TSV, more than 61%; uncertainty remains over whether tokenized shares in self-custodied wallets would receive SIPC protection.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 沃尔玛、礼来、嘉年华邮轮、Arcos Dorados 和信诺加入反对 OKX 与 ICE 代币化股票计划的行列；据 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，原定上市的 62 家企业中已有 38 家提出异议，占比超过 61%。
ranking.latest_update_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados and Cigna joined the opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan; according to the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers have objected, exceeding 61%.
ranking.background_zh: OKXICE TSV是纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与OKX美国控股公司按50比50组建的合资企业，计划通过OKX的XLayer区块链上经许可的Uniswap v4资金池，实现美国股票代币化的7×24小时交易，并以USDC等稳定币作为交易对。其10月4日的初始公告提出上线来自62家公司的63只代币化股票，而包括富国银行和Arm在内的部分后来的反对者并不在最初名单中。SEC于2026年9月17日发布创新豁免，要求交易场所在上线第三方代币化股票版本前至少30天通知相关公司，若公司在期限内书面反对，则该股票不得上线。已获得SEC代币化证券试点批准的纳斯达克表示，将把自家股票排除在该豁免之外。
ranking.background_en: OKXICE TSV is a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's U.S. holding company, planning 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's XLayer blockchain paired with stablecoins such as USDC. Its original Oct. 4 notice proposed 63 tokenized stocks from 62 companies, and several later objectors, including Wells Fargo and Arm, were not on that initial roster. The SEC issued the innovation exemption on Sept. 17, 2026, requiring a venue to notify a company at least 30 days before offering a third-party tokenized version of its shares, with a written objection within that window barring the listing. Nasdaq, which won SEC approval for its own tokenized securities pilot, has said it will opt its shares out of the exemption.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados, and Cigna joined opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan, bringing objecting issuers to 38 of 62, or more than 61%.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados, and Cigna joined opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan, bringing objecting issuers to 38 of 62, or more than 61%.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 这些反对压缩了OKXICE TSV实际可上线的股票供给，在尚未启动前就为这一规模最大的代币化股票场所之一设下可见上限，也检验了在发行人选择退出时SEC豁免能否规模化。该信号还波及更广泛的代币化股票与RWA（现实世界资产）板块——决定哪些股票能够上链交易的约束正在从场所技术转向发行人同意。
ranking.market_impact_en: The objections shrink the supply of equities that OKXICE TSV can actually list, putting a visible ceiling on one of the largest tokenized-equity venues before launch and testing whether the SEC exemption can scale when issuers opt out. The signal extends to the broader tokenized-equity and RWA segment, where issuer consent — rather than venue technology — is emerging as the binding constraint on which stocks can trade onchain.

SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading ...

timeline.text_zh: 沃尔玛、礼来、嘉年华邮轮、Arcos Dorados 和信诺加入反对 OKX 与 ICE 代币化股票计划的行列；据 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，原定上市的 62 家企业中已有 38 家提出异议，占比超过 61%。
timeline.text_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados and Cigna joined the opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan; according to the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers have objected, exceeding 61%.

timeline.text_zh: 据加密记者 Eleanor Terrett 10 月 28 日报道，摩根大通、AMD、应用材料、可口可乐、Adobe、戴尔及 Sandisk 反对 OKXICE 代币化其股份，披露的反对公司总数从 26 家升至 33 家。
timeline.text_en: Crypto reporter Eleanor Terrett reported on Oct. 28 that JPMorgan, AMD, Applied Materials, Coca-Cola, Adobe, Dell and Sandisk objected to OKXICE tokenizing their shares, raising the disclosed number of opposing companies from 26 to 33.

timeline.text_zh: Intel、Oracle、IBM 和 IonQ 加入反对其股票在 OKXICE TSV 被代币化交易的发行方名单，使披露的反对总数从 22 家增至 26 家；10 月 26 日公告还指出，自行托管的代币化股票能否获得 SIPC 保护存在不确定性。
timeline.text_en: Intel, Oracle, IBM and IonQ joined the list of issuers objecting to their shares being tokenized and traded on OKXICE TSV, raising the disclosed total from 22 to 26; the Oct. 26 notice also flagged uncertainty over whether self-custodied tokenized shares would receive SIPC protection.

timeline.text_zh: IBM、Oracle、Intel 和 IonQ 反对 OKX 与 ICE 在未经同意的情况下依据 SEC 创新豁免将其股票代币化，使反对企业总数达到 26 家。
timeline.text_en: IBM, Oracle, Intel and IonQ objected to OKX and ICE tokenizing their stocks without consent under the SEC innovation exemption, bringing the total number of opposing companies to 26.

timeline.text_zh: 参议员 Cynthia Lummis 表示，对加密融资的新限制——将 Reg Crypto 年度豁免上限从 7500 万美元降至 5000 万美元，并增加 2 亿美元终身限额——已被纳入 CLARITY Act，而民主党人最终对这些规则投了反对票。
timeline.text_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said new restrictions on crypto fundraising—lowering the annual Reg Crypto exemption cap from $75M to $50M and adding a $200M lifetime limit—have been incorporated into the CLARITY Act, with Democrats ultimately voting against the rules.

timeline.text_zh: 据路透社看到的一份监管文件，包括富国银行、Arm Holdings和Intuit在内的另外六家公司反对其股票在OKXICE平台被代币化，使已披露的反对发行方总数从16家增至22家；文件未说明这些公司反对的具体原因。
timeline.text_en: A regulatory filing seen by Reuters showed six more companies — including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit — will not allow their shares to be tokenized on the OKXICE platform, raising the total disclosed objecting issuers from 16 to 22; the filing did not state their specific reasons.

timeline.text_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
timeline.text_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.

timeline.text_zh: OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo公开回应发行方反对，称16家企业反对其股票被代币化交易是“正常反应”且符合预期，并重申该模式允许企业自主选择加入或退出。
timeline.text_en: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo publicly responded to issuer opposition, calling the objections from 16 companies to their shares being tokenized a “normal reaction” and expected, while reiterating that the model lets issuers opt in or out.

timeline.text_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛及其他四家公司加入反对其股票在计划中的OKX-洲际交易所代币化股票平台交易的发行人名单，使总数增至16家，而该平台表示也可能上架由发行人自行代币化的股票。
timeline.text_en: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and four other companies joined the list of issuers objecting to their shares being traded on the planned OKX-Intercontinental Exchange tokenized stock venue, raising the total to 16, while the venue said it may also list stocks tokenized by issuers themselves.

timeline.text_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛、高通、卡特彼勒、麦当劳和西部数据这7家企业新提出反对，使已披露的反对发行方总数从9家增至16家（其中15家属于原62家公司名单，Cerebras不在最初名单内），OKXICE于10月19日更新了公开声明。
timeline.text_en: Seven more issuers — Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's and Western Digital — have objected, raising total disclosed objecting issuers from nine to 16 (15 of them on the original 62-company roster, with Cerebras outside that list), per the joint venture's 19 October updated public statement.

ranking.title_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包供应链植入窃密组件事件
ranking.title_en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident
ranking.summary_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入窃密组件事件仍在发展中：Ledger已披露犯罪团伙通过东南亚分销渠道转售被植入设备的做法并收紧销售和交付规则；新加坡警方最新披露当地零售商售出的部分设备含恶意植入，自9月10日以来至少两起案件造成约350万新加坡元损失，Ledger正复核案件，警方调查持续，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911追踪资金。
ranking.summary_en: The Ledger hardware wallet supply-chain implant incident remains developing: Ledger has disclosed that a criminal group redistributed tampered devices through Southeast Asian distribution channels and tightened sales and delivery rules; Singapore police have now disclosed that some devices sold by local retailers contained malicious implants, with at least two cases since September 10 causing about S$3.5 million in losses, while Ledger reviews the cases, police investigations continue, and authorities and SEAL 911 trace funds.
ranking.latest_update_zh: 新加坡警方10月28日披露，当地零售商售出的部分Ledger硬件钱包被植入可窃取助记词或私钥的恶意硬件；自9月10日以来至少报告两起案件，损失约350万新加坡元（约270万美元），Ledger正复核相关案件，警方调查仍在进行。
ranking.latest_update_en: Singapore police disclosed on October 28 that some Ledger hardware wallets sold by local retailers contained malicious hardware implants capable of stealing recovery phrases or private keys; at least two cases have been reported since September 10, causing about S$3.5 million (~$2.7 million) in losses, with Ledger reviewing the cases and police investigations ongoing.
ranking.background_zh: Ledger 是一家法国硬件钱包厂商，2014 年成立于巴黎，其设备将私钥离线保存。恢复短语（又称助记词）是可在另一台设备上恢复非托管钱包及其全部私钥的备份，因此一旦被窃取，硬件钱包的防护意义即被抵消。供应链攻击针对的往往是产品周边的薄弱环节——例如分销与零售渠道，而非厂商自身的系统。
ranking.background_en: Ledger is a French hardware wallet maker founded in Paris in 2014; its devices store private keys offline. A recovery phrase, also called a seed phrase, is the backup that can restore a non-custodial wallet and all its keys on another device, which is why capturing it defeats the purpose of a hardware wallet. Supply-chain attacks target the less-secure links around a product — such as distribution and retail — rather than the manufacturer's own systems.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Singapore police disclosed that Ledger hardware wallets bought from local retailers contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal recovery phrases or private keys, with at least two cases since September 10 causing roughly S$3.5 million ($2.7 million) in losses while Ledger reviews the incidents and investigations continue.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Singapore police disclosed that Ledger hardware wallets bought from local retailers contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal recovery phrases or private keys, with at least two cases since September 10 causing roughly S$3.5 million ($2.7 million) in losses while Ledger reviews the incidents and investigations continue.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 该事件影响的是自托管领域的硬件钱包板块：暴露的是零售分销渠道风险，而非设备固件本身的缺陷，这可能使用户更加关注签名设备的购买来源与渠道。更广泛的市场影响主要经由围绕自托管工具的情绪传导，而非直接作用于资产价格。
ranking.market_impact_en: The incident bears on the hardware-wallet segment of self-custody: it exposes a retail-distribution channel risk rather than a flaw in the devices' firmware, which could shift user scrutiny toward where and how signing devices are sourced. Any broader market effect would run through sentiment around self-custody tooling rather than through asset prices directly.

timeline.text_zh: 新加坡警方10月28日披露，当地零售商售出的部分Ledger硬件钱包被植入可窃取助记词或私钥的恶意硬件；自9月10日以来至少报告两起案件，损失约350万新加坡元（约270万美元），Ledger正复核相关案件，警方调查仍在进行。
timeline.text_en: Singapore police disclosed on October 28 that some Ledger hardware wallets sold by local retailers contained malicious hardware implants capable of stealing recovery phrases or private keys; at least two cases have been reported since September 10, causing about S$3.5 million (~$2.7 million) in losses, with Ledger reviewing the cases and police investigations ongoing.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger披露，一个高度组织化的犯罪团伙花费数百万美元购买正版Ledger设备，植入隐藏组件以在初始化过程中窃取助记词，并通过东南亚分销商转售，促使Ledger暂停销售并更改东南亚和香港授权经销商的交付规则，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911合作追踪资金。
timeline.text_en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group spent millions of dollars buying genuine Ledger devices, implanting hidden components to steal seed phrases during initialization and reselling them via Southeast Asian distributors, prompting Ledger to suspend sales and change delivery rules at authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong while it works with law enforcement and SEAL 911 to trace the funds.

timeline.text_zh: Chainalysis 报告称，一名任务诈骗者因购买三台被篡改的 Ledger 设备而损失 60 BTC（约 480 万美元）；同一供应链攻击的链上被盗资金总额增至逾 1.034 亿美元，涉及 530 个地址。
timeline.text_en: Chainalysis reported a task-scammer lost 60 BTC (~$4.8M) after buying three tampered Ledger devices; the same supply-chain attack's onchain theft total rose to over $103.4M across 530 addresses.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger披露，一个有组织团伙花费数月时间将恶意硬件植入正版Ledger设备，并通过东南亚转售渠道重新分销，以拦截助记词并盗取用户资产；同时确认其安全芯片、BOLOS操作系统和服务器基础设施未遭入侵。
timeline.text_en: Ledger disclosed that an organized syndicate spent months implanting malicious hardware into genuine Ledger devices and redistributing them through Southeast Asian resale channels to intercept seed phrases and drain user assets, while confirming its secure element chips, BOLOS OS, and server infrastructure were not compromised.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger首次将事件正式定性为设备离开公司控制后的局部分销渠道攻击，而非系统性供应链攻击，并称芯片、操作系统及服务器未被攻破；同时收紧渠道规则：退货设备即便看似全新、未开封也不得再次出售，产品不得置于货架或展示区，须在后场存放并在购买时交付，渠道须及时上报异常产品；Ledger还表示已赴德国等地门店购买并拆检设备、检查仓库及自有库存样本，均未发现篡改，并正与执法机构追踪资金。
timeline.text_en: Ledger formally characterized the incident as a localized distribution-channel attack after devices left its control, rather than a systemic supply-chain compromise, saying its chips, OS, and servers were not breached; it also tightened channel rules — returned devices cannot be resold even if seemingly new or unopened, products must not be displayed on shelves and must be stored in backrooms and delivered at purchase, and channels must promptly report anomalous products; Ledger added it bought and inspected devices at stores in Germany and elsewhere and checked warehouses and its own inventory samples without finding tampering, while working with law enforcement to trace funds.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
timeline.text_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.

timeline.text_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。
timeline.text_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道称，Mark Karpelès 已在菲律宾官方经销商 LazMall 销售的 Ledger 钱包中也发现间谍软件，使受影响经销商范围进一步扩大；Ledger 最新声明称尚未核实来自其他渠道购买签名器的资金流出，并正在审查其他签名器和地点的植入物报告，同时 CryptoBilis 在调查期间继续停售。
timeline.text_en: The new report says Mark Karpelès has also found spyware in Ledger wallets sold by official Philippine reseller LazMall, further widening the affected-reseller scope; Ledger’s latest statement says it has not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere and is reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations, while CryptoBilis remains not selling wallets during the investigation.

timeline.text_zh: 新增：Ledger官方确认已与MediaMarkt Saturn协调暂停德国线上及线下门店销售，以配合一名德国用户疑似植入物报告的调查；Ledger表示该报告相关事件暂无资金损失，且无迹象表明其基础设施、系统或服务遭到入侵，客服正在审查报告，Donjon将检查设备。
timeline.text_en: New: Ledger officially confirmed it coordinated with MediaMarkt Saturn to suspend online and in-store sales in Germany pending investigation into a German user's suspected implant report; Ledger said there were no reported fund losses tied to that report and no signs of compromise to its infrastructure, systems, or services, with customer support reviewing the report and Donjon set to inspect devices.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认，东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的钱包中存在未经授权的硬件植入物，该植入物会在设置过程中从设备屏幕读取24词恢复短语，并通过预置eSIM经LTE传输，所有已确认的损失均与通过该经销商购买的设备有关，疑似被盗资金达8600万美元。
timeline.text_en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.

featured.title_zh: 币安遭大规模黑客攻击，公司承担损失并冻结部分被盗资金
featured.title_en: Binance hit by large-scale hack, losses covered by company reserves
featured.summary_zh: 币安仍在处理这起创纪录的约63亿美元黑客事件；其第三次恢复更新称已用逾63.4亿美元公司资金补充约90%的被盗资产，并提供了储备金证明快照。
featured.summary_en: Binance is still handling the record ~$6.3 billion hack; its third recovery update says about 90% of stolen assets have been replenished from more than $6.34 billion in company funds, with a Proof of Reserves snapshot provided.
featured.latest_update_zh: 币安发布第三次恢复更新，称被盗资产中已补充约90%（此前约为80%），资金来自其预留的逾63.4亿美元公司资金，并提供了储备金证明快照。
featured.latest_update_en: Binance's third recovery update said about 90% of stolen assets have now been replenished, up from roughly 80%, using more than $6.34 billion in company funds set aside, and provided a Proof of Reserves snapshot.
featured.background_zh: CFTC于2026年10月5日发布《预先规则制定通知》，就针对加密资产零售商品交易的定制化监管框架公开征求意见，截止日期为2026年10月20日。在《清晰法案》在参议院停滞之后，该机构加快推进自身规则制定，并另行澄清了美国用户接入离岸加密交易所的相关规则。
featured.background_en: The CFTC published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking on Oct. 5, 2026, seeking public comment on a fit-for-purpose framework for crypto-asset retail commodity transactions, with comments due Oct. 20, 2026. The agency has pressed ahead with its own rulemaking after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate, and has separately moved to clarify rules on U.S. access to offshore crypto exchanges.
featured.latest_summary_zh: Binance's third recovery update reports that 90% of the stolen assets from its security incident have now been replenished from over $6.34B in company funds set aside to cover hacked losses, alongside a Proof of Reserves snapshot.
featured.latest_summary_en: Binance's third recovery update reports that 90% of the stolen assets from its security incident have now been replenished from over $6.34B in company funds set aside to cover hacked losses, alongside a Proof of Reserves snapshot.
featured.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于市场准入与托管标准：若离岸交易所可通过"联邦选项"在CFTC注册，美国用户获取离岸流动性的条件，以及这些平台面临的网络安全与签名基础设施要求，都将发生变化。该方案目前仍属提案，因此对交易所准入资格或流动性的实际影响，取决于尚未最终敲定的规则制定进程。
featured.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through market access and custody standards: if offshore venues can register with the CFTC under a federal option, the terms on which U.S. users reach offshore liquidity, and the cybersecurity and signing-infrastructure requirements those venues face, would both change. The proposal remains a proposal, so any effect on venue eligibility or liquidity is contingent on rulemaking that has not been finalized.

timeline.text_zh: 币安发布第三次恢复更新，称被盗资产中已补充约90%（此前约为80%），资金来自其预留的逾63.4亿美元公司资金，并提供了储备金证明快照。
timeline.text_en: Binance's third recovery update said about 90% of stolen assets have now been replenished, up from roughly 80%, using more than $6.34 billion in company funds set aside, and provided a Proof of Reserves snapshot.

timeline.text_zh: 币安遭遇创纪录的63亿美元黑客攻击，表示将自行承担损失而非转嫁给用户，并称约30亿美元被盗资金已被冻结，在11月3日美国大选前引发政治人物评论。
timeline.text_en: Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion hack, said it would absorb the losses rather than pass them to users and reported roughly $3 billion of the stolen funds already frozen, drawing commentary from political figures ahead of the Nov. 3 US election.

timeline.text_zh: 币安表示已覆盖约80%的黑客损失，并称未来几天将重点恢复提现、通过储备金证明加强透明度、追回被冻结资金并发布事件分析报告；初步调查仍未发现钱包私钥泄露证据。
timeline.text_en: Binance said it has covered about 80% of the hack losses and that in the coming days it will focus on restoring withdrawals, strengthening transparency via proof of reserves, recovering frozen funds, and publishing an incident analysis; the preliminary investigation has still found no evidence of wallet private-key leakage.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 公开以币安约64亿美元黑客事件为由，推动对离岸加密交易所实施美国联邦监管；同时币安表示调查发现“更多入侵点”，CEO Richard Teng 称攻击过程更复杂，并非仅利用一名工程师的权限。
timeline.text_en: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig publicly cited Binance's ~$6.4 billion hack to argue for U.S. federal oversight of offshore crypto exchanges; separately, Binance said its investigation uncovered “additional points of breach,” with CEO Richard Teng calling it a more complex attack process that did not simply use one engineer's permissions.

timeline.text_zh: 币安发布第二份安全事件更新，通报调查、基础设施加固以及防范和追回资金损失方面的 24 小时进展，并将此事列为最高优先级。
timeline.text_en: Binance issued a second security incident update, reporting 24-hour progress on investigation, infrastructure hardening, and efforts to prevent and recover fund losses while treating the matter as its top priority.

timeline.text_zh: Decrypt 报道补充了市场影响与资金追回细节：比特币较美联储决议后水平仅下跌约4%–6%，约13亿美元杠杆头寸被清算；攻击者仍持有约42万ETH和18,270 BTC（约24亿美元，无法被稳定币发行方冻结）；币安称约30亿美元已冻结，并正通过公开市场和场外交易买入缺失代币，提现预计约45小时内恢复。
timeline.text_en: Decrypt added market-impact and recovery details: Bitcoin fell only about 4%–6% from its post-Fed level, roughly $1.3 billion in leveraged bets were liquidated; the attacker still holds about 420,000 ETH and 18,270 BTC (~$2.4 billion that stablecoin issuers cannot freeze); Binance says about $3 billion is frozen and it is buying missing tokens on the open market and over the counter, with withdrawals expected to resume in about 45 hours.

timeline.text_zh: 美国特勤局加入币安黑客案调查；Circle 冻结了约8.23亿美元与攻击相关的 USDC，Tether 冻结了约9.751亿美元 USDT，两家稳定币发行方均表示配合执法。
timeline.text_en: The U.S. Secret Service joined the Binance hack investigation; Circle froze approximately $823 million in USDC and Tether froze approximately $975.1 million in USDT connected to the attack, with both stablecoin issuers coordinating with law enforcement.

timeline.text_zh: 加密货币相关股票在币安63亿美元黑客事件后大幅下跌，Coinbase跌超13%，Circle、Strategy、IREN、Figure跌8-10%。
timeline.text_en: Crypto-linked stocks sold off sharply following the $6.3B Binance hack, with Coinbase falling over 13% and Circle, Strategy, IREN, and Figure dropping 8-10%.

timeline.text_zh: 币安 CEO 邓伟政表示，交易所将动用超过 63.4 亿美元的公司储备——其中包括受影响代币中的 50 亿美元——来弥补本周黑客攻击造成的全部损失；此前攻击者利用自毁机制和 EIP-7702 委托绕过了正常的审批控制，提现目标于周日恢复，完整的储备证明于周一公布。
timeline.text_en: Binance CEO Richard Teng said the exchange will cover all losses from this week's hack using more than $6.34 billion of company reserves — including $5 billion in the affected tokens — after an attacker used a self-destruct mechanism and an EIP-7702 delegation to bypass normal approval controls, with withdrawals targeted for restoration by Sunday and a full proof of reserves by Monday.

timeline.text_zh: TRM Labs 和 Chainalysis 将币安约64亿美元黑客攻击归因于朝鲜关联黑客组织 TraderTraitor；同时 CZ 公开回应马斯克对币安事件的嘲讽，币安联席 CEO Yi He 表示公司年收入足以覆盖损失、无需出售 SpaceX 持股。
timeline.text_en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the ~$6.4B Binance hack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor; separately, CZ publicly rebuked Elon Musk over his mockery of Binance, and co-CEO Yi He said annual revenue is sufficient to cover losses without selling SpaceX shares.

featured.title_zh: ICE与Trade.xyz合作推出美国监管的永续期货交易场所
featured.title_en: ICE partners with Trade.xyz to launch US-regulated perpetual futures venue
featured.summary_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 重新发布经修改的合作公告，重申计划推出基于 Hyperliquid 的美国受监管永续期货市场，但强调该计划及杠杆交易均尚待监管批准，尚无获批或上线。
featured.summary_en: ICE and Trade[XYZ] have reposted an amended partnership announcement reiterating plans for a US-regulated perpetual futures venue built on Hyperliquid, while stressing that the plan and leveraged trading remain subject to regulatory approvals; no approval or launch has occurred.
featured.latest_update_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
featured.latest_update_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
featured.background_zh: HIP-3（即“构建者部署永续合约”）是 Hyperliquid 的一项升级，于 2025 年 10 月 13 日在主网上线，允许独立运营者在 Hyperliquid 基础设施上无需许可地创建自己的永续合约市场。永续合约是没有到期日、跟踪标的资产价格的衍生品合约，据 DefiLlama 数据，Hyperliquid 是此类合约全球最大的去中心化交易所。据报道，美国总统特朗普曾在 8 月 19 日表示，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 正在推动以“完全合规且合法的方式”将 Hyperliquid 引入美国。被列为 trade[XYZ] 投资人的亿万富翁投资者 Stanley Druckenmiller 表示“很高兴成为 trade(xyz) 的投资者”，ICE 也进行了战略投资。
featured.background_en: HIP-3, or "Builder-Deployed Perpetuals", is a Hyperliquid upgrade that went live on mainnet on October 13, 2025, allowing independent operators to permissionlessly launch their own perpetual futures markets on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that track an asset's price without an expiration date, and Hyperliquid is the largest decentralized exchange for such instruments by DefiLlama data. According to the reporting, President Donald Trump said on Aug. 19 that CFTC Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in a "fully compliant and legal fashion." Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller, listed as a trade[XYZ] investor, said he was "excited to be an investor in trade(xyz)", and ICE has made a strategic investment.
featured.latest_summary_zh: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
featured.latest_summary_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
featured.market_impact_zh: 该消息直接影响了 Hyperliquid 原生代币 HYPE，其 24 小时内上涨约 20%，价格突破 96 美元，逼近 9 月创下的 97.96 美元历史高点，显示 HYPE 代币与 Hyperliquid 链上永续合约场所是市场对该消息最直接的敞口。由于该计划仍需监管批准且尚未上线，任何向美国受监管场所的推进都将通过监管与清算渠道传导，而非立竿见影的流动性变化。
featured.market_impact_en: The announcement moved Hyperliquid's native token HYPE, which rose about 20% over 24 hours to trade above $96, approaching September's all-time high of $97.96, reflecting how the HYPE token and Hyperliquid's onchain perps venue are the most direct market exposure to the news. Any shift toward a regulated US venue would transmit through the regulatory and clearing channel rather than through immediate liquidity changes, since the plan remains subject to approvals and no market is live.
